content.meta: Six interlocking strands run across the year. Each is independently curated, but every strand answers to the same question: what does light know that we don't?
notes: A field study of light, matter and atmosphere.
Six months of exhibitions, residencies and public lectures across three pavilions.

strands.body: A reading room of long-form essays, drawings and weather notebooks, organised around the changing yellow of late afternoon.
strands.title: Slow Atmospheres

strands.body: Three commissions in three pavilions, each examining how a public square wears its own light over the course of a season.
strands.title: Public Form

strands.body: A residency programme drawing artists, architects and meteorologists together for a hundred days of recording, drawing and arguing.
strands.title: Field Notes

strands.body: A typographic publishing strand committed to printing only what asks to be read in daylight, on warm paper, slowly.
strands.title: Quiet Editions

strands.body: Twelve evenings of public talks, paired with a meal and a question: what is the weather like in your work?
strands.title: Open Conversations
